programme: M.Sc. Data Science and Spatial Analytics
name: Pankaj kori

subjects.name: Mathematics for Spatial Sciences
subjects.teacherNote: Cover linear algebra and coordinate geometry used in GIS. Keep a short sheet for matrices, distances, and transforms.

subjects.name: Statistics and Probability
subjects.teacherNote: Start with distributions, then sampling and inference. Practice describing a dataset before running a test.

subjects.name: Introduction to Geospatial Technology
subjects.teacherNote: Raster vs vector, projections, and GPS basics. Bring a Pune or campus map example to class.

subjects.name: Relational Database Management System
subjects.teacherNote: Keys, 3NF, and joins first. Write the same query in SQL and as a table merge so the idea sticks.

subjects.name: Principles and Practices of Data Protection
subjects.teacherNote: Consent, purpose limitation, and data minimisation. Do not keep identifiers a lab does not need.

subjects.name: Python for Data Science
subjects.teacherNote: pandas, then NumPy, then plots. Lab habit: load a CSV, clean nulls, groupby, and save a reproducible notebook.

subjects.name: Business Communication
subjects.teacherNote: Audience, structure, and a clear ask. Draft one short email and one slide outline after each session.

subjects.name: Research Methodology in Computational Sciences
subjects.teacherNote: Question, data, method, validity. A classmate should be able to repeat your methods section.
